summary: Near-flat kerb where cars park, but homes within 15-25 m on both sides.
reasons: Homes about 14-25 m away both sides

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the street on both sides, 14-25 m from the kerb; no bush or park behind.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with kerbside parking; cars park along it so room to stop is fine.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street; junction traffic nearby.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along both kerbs, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Slope over 3% at 20-50 m; the best section is flat
sun_shade: Street trees and house shade on the west side; open to the afternoon sun from the west only above the fences.

best_section.where: West kerb of Gordon Terrace, midway between the two side-street junctions
